title: Excellent Floating Shelves though a Few Quality Control Issues
text:
Excellent Floating Shelves though a Few Quality Control Issues. After moving into our new house last summer I decided to rethink how I wanted to hook up all of the TVs. Due to the fact we moved away from having cable boxes we really didn’t need anything visible so I utilized these shelves in several locations to hold our steaming devices behind the TV next to the TV’s mount.

There are four sized shelves in this set and I’ve ended up using all of them.

Since I was mounting in such a way that they really aren’t visible but more functional I mounted with the brackets turned upwards and the shelf resting within. After testing both ways I felt this provided a bit of added security in that items couldn’t slide off the edge. By utilizing the opening in the triangular bracket to snake the cables through it further locked the devices into place.

These shelves have worked perfectly for my uses but I will point out that 2 of the 4 shelves appear to have gray stain dripped over the top of them and not wiped away before drying. This is sloppy and an example of poor quality control. For my use where the shelves are hung high and behind a TV it was OK but I would not want that visible.

Due to this lack of quality control I must give these shelves a 3 star review though without the drips they would definitely be 5 star.
